record.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect about Aadhaar?
options: Aadhaar number is a 12 digit unique number for every single individual
It is not mandatory to enroll for Aadhaar
Only a permanent resident of India is eligible to apply for Aadhaar
A child of age less than 3 years does not require giving biometric information
record.explanation: Answer C. As of this January 2015 paper, Aadhaar eligibility was based on resident status, not permanent residence. A resident need not be a permanent resident or Indian citizen; the Act defines a resident by 182 days of residence in the preceding 12 months. Reviewed against the historical rule, not current enrollment practice.
